scope: controlled relational preference checks for E1-E5
method: Checks are recomputed from all_runs.csv and compare profile behaviour relationally rather than against hardcoded timetable values.

checks.name: E1 all canonical profiles reach a proven optimum
checks.description: The E1 control environment should remain solvable under every profile.

checks.name: E1 profiles agree when no meaningful preference trade-off exists
checks.description: All five profiles should select the same passenger journey time in E1.

checks.name: E2 Fastest accepts a transfer for a shorter journey
checks.description: Fastest should have a shorter journey time than Fewer Transfers.

checks.name: E2 Fewer Transfers uses fewer train changes than Fastest
checks.description: The transfer-focused profile should reduce transfer count relative to Fastest.

checks.name: E3 Fastest chooses the quicker itinerary
checks.description: Fastest should arrive sooner than the transfer-timing profile.

checks.name: E3 Less Waiting chooses transfer timing closer to the six-step ideal
checks.description: The transfer-timing profile should reduce absolute deviation from the preferred six-step connection.

checks.name: E4 Fastest is quicker than Simple Journey
checks.description: Fastest should trade greater route complexity for a shorter journey.

checks.name: E4 Simple Journey uses fewer turns than Fastest
checks.description: Simple Journey should reduce route turns relative to Fastest.

checks.name: E5 Fastest chooses a shorter journey than Fewer Transfers
checks.description: The integrated environment should preserve the journey-time versus transfer-count trade-off.

checks.name: E5 Fewer Transfers reduces train changes relative to Fastest
checks.description: The integrated transfer-focused profile should use fewer transfers than Fastest.
